decisions.reason: Requesting an editorial review of the paperback cover does not change the independently required back matter or author copy.
The KDP assistance clause independently introduces this Requirement and is already represented; the cover-review modification does not alter it.
Editorial review of the supplied cover does not change the paperback interior layout, publication format, or trim-size requirements.
The source requests review of the cover, not changes to chapter illustrations, their placement, size, or visual-review criteria.
The cover-review decision has no necessary effect on table-of-contents page numbering or its update timing.
The requested cover review does not modify the copyright-page publisher line or layout.
Reviewing the paperback cover does not change the Chapter 12 heading hierarchy or capitalization requirements.
The source concerns the separately supplied cover and does not resolve or modify the interior title-page layout ambiguity.
The cover-specific editorial review request does not change the manuscript copyediting goal or approved passages.
The cover-review request does not alter the requirement prohibiting the literal newline artifact in the interior book title.
